diff: --- /dev/null +++ b/src/slatepress/markdown.py @@ -0,0 +1,38 @@ +src/slatepress/markdown.py +import re + +def inline_markup(text: str) -> str: + """Apply inline markup to text: bold, italic, and inline code. + HTML special characters are escaped first. + """ + # Escape HTML special characters: &, <, > + text = text.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") + + # Extract code spans: content between single backticks + code_pattern = re.compile(r'`([^`]*)`') + placeholders = [] + + def replace_code(match): + # Store the content inside the backticks (without the backticks) + placeholders.append(match.group(1)) + # Return a unique placeholder + return f"__SLATEPRESS_CODE_PLACEHOLDER_{len(placeholders)-1}__" + + # Replace code spans with placeholders + text_without_code = code_pattern.sub(replace_code, text) + + # Apply bold: **text** -> text + bold_pattern = re.compile(r'\*\*(.*?)\*\*', re.DOTALL) + text_without_code = bold_pattern.sub(r'\1', text_without_code) + + # Apply italic: *text* -> text + italic_pattern = re.compile(r'\*(.*?)\*', re.DOTALL) + text_without_code = italic_pattern.sub(r'\1', text_without_code) + + # Replace placeholders with content + for idx, content in enumerate(placeholders): + placeholder = f"__SLATEPRESS_CODE_PLACEHOLDER_{idx}__" + text_without_code = text_without_code.replace(placeholder, f"{content}") + + return text_without_code +
